findings.note: SportsLine's simulation model picks Over 40. It projects 48 combined points and says the Over has hit in three of the last four head-to-head meetings and in each of Jacksonville's last two games.

Third-string QB Joe Fagnano is set to start with Lamar Jackson headed to IR and Tyler Huntley hurt. Baltimore is finalizing a trade for veteran QB Jacoby Brissett, which could upgrade the offense if he plays, and the total has already fallen from 48.5.
SportsLine's Mike Tierney leans Under 39.5, the same line as this bet. He points to Jacksonville allowing the second-fewest points per game (15.9) and the Ravens' banged-up third-string QB.
